verdict.rationale: Docs show virtual cards scoped to a single task/session with automatic invalidation after use, plus per-authorization spending limits and merchant/category/MID blocking, directly matching the single-use, merchant/amount-scoped card story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that a leaked single-use card number is actually rejected after first use, and no explicit doc excerpt confirming exact-amount (not just max-limit) enforcement per authorization.
